name: Aurum Internet
summary: Kalgoorlie WA dialup ISP (Brandis Holdings Pty Ltd, aurum.net.au); acquired by WestNet c.1999-2000.

events.details: Kalgoorlie WA ISP; earliest Wayback capture 11 Nov 1998 (aurum.net.au).
Acquired by WestNet (aurum.net.au served WestNet from Aug 2000; still WestNet-served in captures through Aug 2007).
ABN 33 609 989 157 (AURUM & CO. PTY LTD, active from 27 Dec 2015, QLD) is an unrelated later entity, not this Kalgoorlie ISP; previously miscited here.
